cleanTiming.method: One fresh context with unwrapped180-RAF warmup,300-RAF baseline and300-RAF24-death load. Exact reference IDs/camera. No runtime wrappers, CPU profiles or GPU timing queries. CDP Performance counters read only outside windows.
cleanTiming.coordination: Root, physics and city confirmed heavy CPU paused before this single clean sample; no simultaneous Chrome or Blender run.

limitations: Reverse impact required 22.99 seconds before first native sleep, then 2 continuous seconds of invariant sleep. This remains visibly slow settling despite the eventual pass.
The original independent 27.661-second settling case remains preserved; neither extending the observation cap nor this different pose establishes a general settling fix.
Clean 24-death load averages 56.94 FPS, with 16 of 300 intervals over 25 ms and p95 of 33.3 ms. It is not locked at 60 FPS.
Functional capture timing is instrumented and is not used as the performance benchmark.
Same civilian IDs/camera do not produce bit-for-bit identical contact trajectories across browser runs.
No collision fidelity, corpse count, shape, mask or 12-iteration loaded solver setting was reduced. This bounded verification is not an AAA-quality claim.
